name: Rice Krispies Treats
desc: Thick, gooey marshmallow and butter cereal bars with extra whole marshmallows folded in.

source.title: Rice Krispie Treats {Thick & Gooey}
source.evidence: Same 6 tbsp butter, 16 oz bag of mini marshmallows with whole marshmallows folded in at the end, and vanilla; Two Peas adds 2 cups extra marshmallows and 8 cups cereal where this one holds back 1 cup from the bag and uses 6 cups.

ingredients.raw: 6 tbsp unsalted butter, plus more for the spatula

steps: Line an 8x8-inch pan with parchment paper (use a 9x13-inch pan for thinner bars). Measure out 1 cup of the marshmallows and set aside.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-low heat. Add the rest of the marshmallows and stir constantly until only melted. Overcooking turns the bars hard.
Remove from the heat. Stir in the vanilla, then fold in the cereal and the reserved 1 cup marshmallows until evenly coated.
Transfer to the pan and press gently into an even layer with a buttered spatula. Do not pack it down.
Let set at room temperature at least 1 hour, then cut into 16 squares.
tips: Store airtight at room temperature, with parchment between layers, up to 3 days.
